name: Yaw Sharpmane
summary: In Bloodhoof Village, Yaw Sharpmane guides young tauren hunters. He teaches them to track, survive, and tame Mulgore's wild beasts.

sections.title: A Guide on the Plains
sections.body: Yaw Sharpmane teaches marksmanship, tracking, and survival in Bloodhoof Village. Young hunters who have proven themselves in Red Cloud Mesa come to him to hone their skills before venturing onto the wider plains of Mulgore.

sections.title: Mastering the Bond
sections.body: Yaw Sharpmane guides new hunters through the ancient rite of taming wild beasts. He asks them to bond with Mulgore's native animals, testing their patience and respect for nature's balance. Then he teaches them to care for and train a lasting companion.

faq.answer: Yaw Sharpmane trains hunters in Bloodhoof Village. He teaches young tauren marksmanship, wilderness survival, and how to tame animal companions.

faq.q: Where can I find Yaw Sharpmane?
faq.answer: You can find Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village, in central Mulgore along the shores of Stonebull Lake.

faq.q: What does Yaw Sharpmane teach hunters?
faq.answer: Yaw Sharpmane teaches hunters basic abilities and guides promising hunters through the rites of taming and commanding beasts.
Yaw Sharpmane guides tauren hunters through the beast-taming trials, from 'The Hunter's Path' to 'Taming the Beast' and 'Training the Beast.'

faq.q: Why do hunters need to speak to him around level 10?
faq.answer: When you reach your tenth season, you go to Yaw Sharpmane to learn how to capture, feed, and command a lasting animal companion from Mulgore's wilds.

faq.q: Does Yaw Sharpmane interact with non-hunters?
aliases: can other classes talk to yaw
faq.answer: Yaw Sharpmane speaks politely with travelers of other callings, though his knowledge and trials are for hunters.

angles.text: As a tauren hunter leaving Red Cloud Mesa, Yaw Sharpmane can guide you as you bond with your first wild companion.
As a tauren, you follow the Shu'halo tradition of living in harmony with nature and honoring Mulgore's wild beasts.
